title: 1. Computer Organization and Architecture MCQ on Basic Structures of Computers

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Functional Units of a Computer”.

mcqs.question: The ______ format is usually used to store data.
mcqs.explanation: The data usually used by computers have to be stored and represented in a particular format for ease of use.

mcqs.question: The 8-bit encoding format used to store data in a computer is ______
mcqs.explanation: The data to be stored in the computers have to be encoded in a particular way so as to provide secure processing of the data.

mcqs.question: A source program is usually in _______
mcqs.explanation: The program written and before being compiled or assembled is called as a source program.

mcqs.question: Which memory device is generally made of semiconductors?
mcqs.explanation: Memory devices are usually made of semiconductors for faster manipulation of the contents.

mcqs.question: The small extremely fast, RAM’s are called as _______
mcqs.explanation: These small and fast memory devices are compared to RAM because they optimize the performance of the system and they only keep files which are required by the current process in them

mcqs.question: The ALU makes use of _______ to store the intermediate results.
mcqs.explanation: The ALU is the computational center of the CPU. It performs all mathematical and logical operations. In order to perform better, it uses some internal memory spaces to store immediate results.

mcqs.question: The control unit controls other units by generating ___________
mcqs.explanation: This unit is used to control and coordinate between the various parts and components of the CPU.

mcqs.question: ______ are numbers and encoded characters, generally used as operands.
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The Input devices can send information to the processor.

options.a: a) When the SIN status flag is set
options.b: b) When the data arrives regardless of the SIN flag

mcqs.answer: a) When the SIN status flag is set
mcqs.explanation: The input devices use buffers to store the data received and when the buffer has some data it sends it to the processor.

mcqs.question: ______ bus structure is usually used to connect I/O devices.
mcqs.explanation: BUS is a bunch of wires which carry address, control signals and data. It is used to connect various components of the computer.

mcqs.question: The I/O interface required to connect the I/O device to the bus consists of ______

options.c: c) Address decoder, registers and Control circuits

mcqs.answer: c) Address decoder, registers and Control circuits
mcqs.explanation: The I/O devices are connected to the CPU via BUS and to interact with the BUS they have an interface.

mcqs.question: To reduce the memory access time we generally make use of  ______
mcqs.explanation: The time required to access a part of the memory for data retrieval.

mcqs.question: ______ is generally used to increase the apparent size of physical memory.
mcqs.explanation: Virtual memory is like an extension to the existing memory.

mcqs.question: MFC stands for ___________
mcqs.explanation: This is a system command enabled when a memory function is completed by a process.

mcqs.question: The time delay between two successive initiations of memory operation _______
mcqs.explanation: The time is taken to finish one task and to start another.

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Basic Operational Concept”.

mcqs.question: The decoded instruction is stored in ______
mcqs.explanation: The instruction after obtained from the PC, is decoded and operands are fetched and stored in the IR.

mcqs.question: The instruction -> Add LOCA, R0 does _______

options.a: a) Adds the value of LOCA to R0 and stores in the temp register
options.b: b) Adds the value of R0 to the address of LOCA
options.c: c) Adds the values of both LOCA and R0 and stores it in R0
options.d: d) Adds the value of LOCA with a value in accumulator and stores it in R0

mcqs.answer: c) Adds the values of both LOCA and R0 and stores it in R0
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: Which registers can interact with the secondary storage?
mcqs.explanation: MAR can interact with secondary storage in order to fetch data from it.

mcqs.question: During the execution of a program which gets initialized first?
mcqs.explanation: For the execution of a process first the instruction is placed in the PC.

mcqs.question: Which of the register/s of the processor is/are connected to Memory Bus?
mcqs.explanation: MAR is connected to the memory BUS in order to access the memory.

mcqs.question: ISP stands for _________
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The internal components of the processor are connected by _______
mcqs.explanation: The processor BUS is used to connect the various parts in order to provide a direct connection to the CPU.

mcqs.question: ______ is used to choose between incrementing the PC or performing ALU operations.
mcqs.explanation: The multiplexer circuit is used to choose between the two as it can give different results based on the input.

mcqs.question: The registers, ALU and the interconnection between them are collectively called as _____
mcqs.explanation: The Operational and processing part of the CPU are collectively called as a data path.

mcqs.question: _______ is used to store data in registers.
mcqs.explanation: None.

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “BUS Structure”.

mcqs.question: The main virtue for using single Bus structure is ____________

options.b: b) Cost effective connectivity and speed
options.c: c) Cost effective connectivity and ease of attaching peripheral devices

mcqs.answer: c) Cost effective connectivity and ease of attaching peripheral devices
mcqs.explanation: By using a single BUS structure we can minimize the amount of hardware (wire) required and thereby reducing the cost.

mcqs.question: ______ are used to overcome the difference in data transfer speeds of various devices.
mcqs.explanation: By using Buffer registers, the processor sends the data to the I/O device at the processor speed and the data gets stored in the buffer. After that the data gets sent to or from the buffer to the devices at the device speed.

mcqs.question: To extend the connectivity of the processor bus we use ________
mcqs.explanation: PCI BUS is used to connect other peripheral devices that require a direct connection with the processor.

mcqs.question: IBM developed a bus standard for their line of computers ‘PC AT’ called _____
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: ANSI stands for __________
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: _____ register Connected to the Processor bus is a single-way transfer capable.
mcqs.explanation: The Z register is a special register which can interact with the processor BUS only.

mcqs.question: In multiple Bus organisation, the registers are collectively placed and referred as ______
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The main advantage of multiple bus organisation over a single bus is _____

options.a: a) Reduction in the number of cycles for execution
options.b: b) Increase in size of the registers

mcqs.answer: a) Reduction in the number of cycles for execution
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The ISA standard Buses are used to connect ___________
mcqs.explanation: None.

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Performance of a System”.

mcqs.question: During the execution of the instructions, a copy of the instructions is placed in the ______
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: Two processors A and B have clock frequencies of 700 Mhz and 900 Mhz respectively. Suppose A can execute an instruction with an average of 3 steps and B can execute with an average of 5 steps. For the execution of the same instruction which processor is faster?

options.c: c) Both take the same time

mcqs.explanation: The performance of a system can be found out using the Basic performance formula.

mcqs.question: A processor performing fetch or decoding of different instruction during the execution of another instruction is called ______
mcqs.explanation: Pipe-lining is the process of improving the performance of the system by processing different instructions at the same time, with only one instruction performing one specific operation.

mcqs.question: For a given FINITE number of instructions to be executed, which architecture of the processor provides for a faster execution?
mcqs.explanation: In super-scalar architecture, the instructions are set in groups and they’re decoded and executed together reducing the amount of time required to process them.

mcqs.question: The clock rate of the processor can be improved by _________

options.a: a) Improving the IC technology of the logic circuits
options.b: b) Reducing the amount of processing done in one step
options.c: c) By using the overclocking method

mcqs.explanation: The clock rate(frequency of the processor) is the hardware dependent quantity it is fixed for a given processor.

mcqs.question: An optimizing Compiler does _________

options.a: a) Better compilation of the given piece of code
options.b: b) Takes advantage of the type of processor and reduces its process time

mcqs.answer: b) Takes advantage of the type of processor and reduces its process time
mcqs.explanation: An optimizing compiler is a compiler designed for the specific purpose of increasing the operation speed of the processor by reducing the time taken to compile the program instructions.

mcqs.question: The ultimate goal of a compiler is to ________

options.a: a) Reduce the clock cycles for a programming task
options.b: b) Reduce the size of the object code
options.d: d) Be able to detect even the smallest of errors

mcqs.answer: a) Reduce the clock cycles for a programming task
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: SPEC stands for _______
mcqs.explanation: SPEC is a corporation that started to standardize the evaluation method of a system’s performance.

mcqs.question: As of 2000, the reference system to find the performance of a system is _____
mcqs.explanation: In SPEC system of measuring a system’s performance, a system is used as a reference against which other systems are compared and performance is determined.

mcqs.question: When Performing a looping operation, the instruction gets stored in the ______
mcqs.explanation: When a looping or branching operation is carried out the offset value is stored in the cache along with the data.

mcqs.question: The average number of steps taken to execute the set of instructions can be made to be less than one by following _______
mcqs.explanation: The number of steps required to execute a given set of instructions is sufficiently reduced by using super-scaling. In this method, a set of instructions are grouped together and are processed.

mcqs.question: If a processor clock is rated as 1250 million cycles per second, then its clock period is ________
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: If the instruction, Add R1, R2, R3 is executed in a system that is pipe-lined, then the value of S is (Where S is a term of the Basic performance equation)?
mcqs.explanation: S is the number of steps required to execute the instructions.

mcqs.question: CISC stands for _______
mcqs.explanation: CISC is a type of system architecture where complex instructions are grouped together and executed to improve system performance.

mcqs.question: As of 2000, the reference system to find the SPEC rating are built with _____ Processor.
mcqs.explanation: None.

title: 2. Computer Architecture Multiple Choice Questions on Machine Instructions and Programs

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Addressing Modes”.

mcqs.question: The instruction, Add #45,R1 does _______

options.a: a) Adds the value of 45 to the address of R1 and stores 45 in that address
options.b: b) Adds 45 to the value of R1 and stores it in R1
options.c: c) Finds the memory location 45 and adds that content to that of R1

mcqs.answer: b) Adds 45 to the value of R1 and stores it in R1
mcqs.explanation: The instruction is using immediate addressing mode hence the value is stored in the location 45 is added.

mcqs.question: In the case of, Zero-address instruction method the operands are stored in _____
mcqs.explanation: In this case, the operands are implicitly loaded onto the ALU.

mcqs.question: Add #45, when this instruction is executed the following happen/s _______

options.a: a) The processor raises an error and requests for one more operand
options.b: b) The value stored in memory location 45 is retrieved and one more operand is requested
options.c: c) The value 45 gets added to the value on the stack and is pushed onto the stack

mcqs.answer: b) The value stored in memory location 45 is retrieved and one more operand is requested
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The addressing mode which makes use of in-direction pointers is ______
mcqs.explanation: In this addressing mode, the value of the register serves as another memory location and hence we use pointers to get the data.

mcqs.question: In the following indexed addressing mode instruction, MOV 5(R1), LOC the effective address is ______
mcqs.explanation: This instruction is in Base with offset addressing mode.

mcqs.question: The addressing mode/s, which uses the PC instead of a general purpose register is  ______

options.d: d) Both Indexed with offset and direct

mcqs.explanation: In this, the contents of the PC are directly incremented.

mcqs.question:
When we use auto increment or auto decrements, which of the following is/are true? 1) In both, the address is used to retrieve the operand and then the address gets altered
2) In auto increment, the operand is retrieved first and then the address altered
3) Both of them can be used on general purpose registers as well as memory locations
mcqs.explanation: In the case of, auto increment the increment is done afterward and in auto decrement the decrement is done first.

mcqs.question: The addressing mode, where you directly specify the operand value is _______
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The effective address of the following instruction is MUL 5(R1,R2).
mcqs.explanation: The addressing mode used is base with offset and index.

mcqs.question: _____ addressing mode is most suitable to change the normal sequence of execution of instructions.
mcqs.explanation: The relative addressing mode is used for this since it directly updates the PC.

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Numbers and Arithmetic Operations”.

mcqs.question: Which method/s of representation of numbers occupies a large amount of memory than others?
mcqs.explanation: It takes more memory as one bit used up to store the sign.

mcqs.question: Which representation is most efficient to perform arithmetic operations on the numbers?
mcqs.explanation: The two’s complement form is more suitable to perform arithmetic operations as there is no need to involve the sign of the number into consideration.

mcqs.question: Which method of representation has two representations for ‘0’?
mcqs.explanation: For an 8-bit number, in Sign-magnitude, +0 is 00000000, and -0 is 10000000. Similarly, in 1’s complementation representation, +0 is 00000000 and -0 is 11111111.

mcqs.question: When we perform subtraction on -7 and 1 the answer in 2’s complement form is _________
mcqs.explanation: First the 2’s complement is found and that is added to the number and the overflow is ignored.

mcqs.question: When we perform subtraction on -7 and -5 the answer in 2’s complement form is ________
mcqs.explanation: First the 2’s complement is found and that is added to the number and the overflow is ignored.

mcqs.question: When we subtract -3 from 2 , the answer in 2’s complement form is _________
mcqs.explanation: First the 2’s complement is found and that is added to the number and the overflow is ignored.

mcqs.question: The processor keeps track of the results of its operations using flags called ________
mcqs.explanation: These flags are used to indicate if there is an overflow or carry or zero result occurrence.

mcqs.question: The register used to store the flags is called as _________
mcqs.explanation: The status register stores the condition codes of the system.

mcqs.question: The Flag ‘V’ is set to 1 indicates that _____________

options.c: c) The operation has resulted in an overflow

mcqs.answer: c) The operation has resulted in an overflow
mcqs.explanation: This is used to check the overflow occurs in the operation.

mcqs.question: In some pipelined systems, a different instruction is used to add to numbers which can affect the flags upon execution. That instruction is _______
mcqs.explanation: By using this instruction the condition flags won’t be affected at all.

mcqs.question: The most efficient method followed by computers to multiply two unsigned numbers is _______

options.b: b) Bit pair recording of multipliers

mcqs.answer: b) Bit pair recording of multipliers
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: For the addition of large integers, most of the systems make use of ______
mcqs.explanation: In this method, the carries for each step are generated first.

mcqs.question: In a normal n-bit adder, to find out if an overflow as occurred we make use of ________
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: In the implementation of a Multiplier circuit in the system we make use of _______
mcqs.explanation: The shift registers are used to store the multiplied answer.

mcqs.question: When 1101 is used to divide 100010010 the remainder is ______
mcqs.explanation: None.

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Memory Locations and Addresses”.

mcqs.question: The smallest entity of memory is called _______
mcqs.explanation: Each data is made up of a number of units.

mcqs.question: The collection of the above mentioned entities where data is stored is called ______
mcqs.explanation: Each readable part of the data is called blocks.

mcqs.question: An 24 bit address generates an address space of ______ locations.
mcqs.explanation: The number of addressable locations in the system is called as address space.

mcqs.question: If a system is 64 bit machine, then the length of each word will be _______
mcqs.explanation: A 64 bit system means, that at a time 64 bit instruction can be executed.

mcqs.question: The type of memory assignment used in Intel processors is _____
mcqs.explanation: The method of address allocation to data to be stored is called as memory assignment.

mcqs.question: When using the Big Endian assignment to store a number, the sign bit of the number is stored in _____

options.a: a) The higher order byte of the word
options.b: b) The lower order byte of the word

mcqs.answer: a) The higher order byte of the word
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: To get the physical address from the logical address generated by CPU we use ____________
mcqs.explanation: Memory Management Unit, is used to add the offset to the logical address generated by the CPU to get the physical address.

mcqs.question: _____ method is used to map logical addresses of variable length onto physical memory.
mcqs.explanation: Segmentation is a process in which memory is divided into groups of variable length called segments.

mcqs.question: During the transfer of data between the processor and memory we use  ______
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: Physical memory is divided into sets of finite size called as ______
mcqs.explanation: None.

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Memory Operations and Management”.

mcqs.question: Add #%01011101,R1 , when this instruction is executed then _________

options.a: a) The binary addition between the operands takes place
options.b: b) The Numerical value represented by the binary value is added to the value of R1
options.c: c) The addition doesn’t take place, whereas this is similar to a MOV instruction

mcqs.answer: a) The binary addition between the operands takes place
mcqs.explanation: This performs operations in binary mode directly.

mcqs.question: If we want to perform memory or arithmetic operations on data in Hexa-decimal mode then we use _________ symbol before the operand.
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: When generating physical addresses from a logical address the offset is stored in __________
mcqs.explanation: In the MMU the relocation register stores the offset address.

mcqs.question: The technique used to store programs larger than the memory is ____________

options.d: d) Both Extension registers and Buffers

mcqs.explanation: In this, only a part of the program getting executed is stored on the memory and later swapped in for the other part.

mcqs.question: The unit which acts as an intermediate agent between memory and backing store to reduce process time is ___________
mcqs.explanation: The cache’s help in data transfers by storing most recently used memory pages.

mcqs.question: Does the Load instruction do the following operation/s?

options.a: a) Loads the contents of a disc onto a memory location
options.b: b) Loads the contents of a location onto the accumulators
options.c: c) Load the contents of the PCB onto the register

mcqs.answer: b) Loads the contents of a location onto the accumulators
mcqs.explanation: The load instruction is basically used to load the contents of a memory location onto a register.

mcqs.question: Complete the following analogy:- Registers are to RAM’s as Cache’s are to ___________
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The BOOT sector files of the system are stored in ___________

options.d: d) Fast solid state chips in the motherboard

mcqs.explanation: The files which are required for the starting up of a system are stored on the ROM.

mcqs.question: The transfer of large chunks of data with the involvement of the processor is done by _______
mcqs.explanation: This mode of transfer involves the transfer of a large block of data from the memory.

mcqs.question: Which of the following techniques used to effectively utilize main memory?

options.d: d) Both  Dynamic linking and loading

mcqs.explanation: In this method only when the routine is required is loaded and hence saves memory.

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Instructions and Instruction Sequencing”.

mcqs.question: RTN stands for ___________
mcqs.explanation: This is the way of writing the assembly language code with the help of register notations.

mcqs.question: The instruction, Add Loc,R1 in RTN is _______

options.c: c) Not possible to write in RTN

mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: Can you perform an addition on three operands simultaneously in ALN using Add instruction?

options.b: b) Not possible using Add, we’ve to use AddSetCC

mcqs.explanation: You cannot perform an addition on three operands simultaneously because the third operand is where the result is stored.

mcqs.question: The instruction, Add R1,R2,R3 in RTN is _______
mcqs.explanation: In RTN the first operand is the destination and the second operand is the source.

mcqs.question: In a system, which has 32 registers the register id is __________ long.
mcqs.explanation: The ID is the name tag given to each of the registers and used to identify them.

mcqs.question: The two phases of executing an instruction are __________

options.b: b) Instruction fetch and instruction execution
options.d: d) Instruction fetch and Instruction processing

mcqs.answer: b) Instruction fetch and instruction execution
mcqs.explanation: First, the instructions are fetched and decoded and then they’re executed and stored.

mcqs.question: The Instruction fetch phase ends with _________

options.a: a) Placing the data from the address in MAR into MDR
options.b: b) Placing the address of the data into MAR
options.c: c) Completing the execution of the data and placing its storage address into MAR
options.d: d) Decoding the data in MDR and placing it in IR

mcqs.answer: d) Decoding the data in MDR and placing it in IR
mcqs.explanation: The fetch ends with the instruction getting decoded and being placed in the IR and the PC getting incremented.

mcqs.question: While using the iterative construct (Branching) in execution _____________ instruction is used to check the condition.
mcqs.explanation: Branch instruction is used to check the test condition and to perform the memory jump with the help of offset.

mcqs.question: When using Branching, the usual sequencing of the PC is altered. A new instruction is loaded which is called as ______
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The condition flag Z is set to 1 to indicate _______

options.a: a) The operation has resulted in an error
options.b: b) The operation requires an interrupt call
options.d: d) There is no empty register available

mcqs.explanation: This condition flag is used to check if the arithmetic operation yields a zero output.

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Assembly Language”.

mcqs.question: __________ converts the programs written in assembly language into machine instructions.
mcqs.explanation: An assembler is a software used to convert the programs into machine instructions.

mcqs.question: The instructions like MOV or ADD are called as ______
mcqs.explanation: This OP – codes tell the system what operation to perform on the operands.

mcqs.question: The alternate way of writing the instruction, ADD #5,R1 is ______

options.d: d) There is no other way

mcqs.explanation: The ADDI instruction, means the addition is in immediate addressing mode.

mcqs.question: Instructions which won’t appear in the object program are called as _____
mcqs.explanation: The directives help the program in getting compiled and hence won’t be there in the object code.

mcqs.question: The assembler directive EQU, when used in the instruction: Sum EQU 200 does ________

options.a: a) Finds the first occurrence of Sum and assigns value 200 to it
options.b: b) Replaces every occurrence of Sum with 200
options.c: c) Re-assigns the address of Sum by adding 200 to its original address
options.d: d) Assigns 200 bytes of memory starting the location of Sum

mcqs.answer: b) Replaces every occurrence of Sum with 200
mcqs.explanation: This basically is used to replace the variable with a constant value.

mcqs.question: The purpose of the ORIGIN directive is __________

options.a: a) To indicate the starting position in memory, where the program block is to be stored
options.b: b) To indicate the starting of the computation code
options.c: c) To indicate the purpose of the code
options.d: d) To list the locations of all the registers used

mcqs.answer: a) To indicate the starting position in memory, where the program block is to be stored
mcqs.explanation: This does the function similar to the main statement.

mcqs.question: The directive used to perform initialization before the execution of the code is ______
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: _____ directive is used to specify and assign the memory required for the block of code.
mcqs.explanation: This instruction is used to allocate a block of memory and to store the object code of the program there.

mcqs.question: _____ directive specifies the end of execution of a program.
mcqs.explanation: This instruction directive is used to terminate the program execution.

mcqs.question: The last statement of the source program should be _______
mcqs.explanation: This enables the processor to load some other process.

mcqs.question: When dealing with the branching code the assembler ___________

options.a: a) Replaces the target with its address
options.b: b) Does not replace until the test condition is satisfied
options.c: c) Finds the Branch offset and replaces the Branch target with it
options.d: d) Replaces the target with the value specified by the DATAWORD directive

mcqs.answer: c) Finds the Branch offset and replaces the Branch target with it
mcqs.explanation: When the assembler comes across the branch code, it immediately finds the branch offset and replaces it with it.

mcqs.question: The assembler stores all the names and their corresponding values in ______
mcqs.explanation: The table where the assembler stores the variable names along with their corresponding memory locations and values.

mcqs.question: The assembler stores the object code in  ______
mcqs.explanation: After compiling the object code, the assembler stores it in the magnetic disk and waits for further execution.

mcqs.question: The utility program used to bring the object code into memory for execution is ______
mcqs.explanation: The program is used to load the program into memory.

mcqs.question: To overcome the problems of the assembler in dealing with branching code we use _____
mcqs.explanation: This creates entries into the symbol table first and then creates the object code.

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Subroutines and Nesting”.

mcqs.question: The return address of the Sub-routine is pointed to by _______
mcqs.explanation: The return address from the subroutine is pointed to by the PC.

mcqs.question: The location to return to, from the subroutine is stored in _______
mcqs.explanation: The registers store the return address of the routine and is pointed to by the PC.

mcqs.question: What is subroutine nesting?

options.a: a) Having multiple subroutines in a program
options.b: b) Using a linking nest statement to put many subroutines under the same name
options.c: c) Having one routine call the other

mcqs.answer: c) Having one routine call the other
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The order in which the return addresses are generated and used is _________
mcqs.explanation: That is the routine called first is returned first.

mcqs.question: In case of nested subroutines the return addresses are stored in __________
mcqs.explanation: In this case, there will be more number of return addresses it is stored on the processor stack.

mcqs.question: The appropriate return addresses are obtained with the help of ____ in case of nested routines.
mcqs.explanation: The pointers are used to point to the location on the stack where the address is stored.

mcqs.question: When parameters are being passed on to the subroutines they are stored in ________
mcqs.explanation: In the case of, parameter passing the data can be stored on any of the storage space.

mcqs.question: The most efficient way of handling parameter passing is by using ______
mcqs.explanation: By using general purpose registers for the parameter passing we make the process more efficient.

mcqs.question: The most Flexible way of logging the return addresses of the subroutines is by using _______
mcqs.explanation: The stacks are used as Logs for return addresses of the subroutines.

mcqs.question:
The wrong statement/s regarding interrupts and subroutines among the following is/are ______ i) The sub-routine and interrupts have a return statement
ii) Both of them alter the content of the PC
iii) Both are software oriented
iv) Both can be initiated by the user
mcqs.explanation: None.

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Parameter Passing and Stack Frame”.

mcqs.question: The private work space dedicated to a subroutine is called as ________
mcqs.explanation: This work space is where the intermediate values of the subroutines are stored.

mcqs.question: If the subroutine exceeds the private space allocated to it then the values are pushed onto _________
mcqs.explanation: If the allocated work space is exceeded then the data is pushed onto the system stack.

mcqs.question: ______ pointer is used to point to parameters passed or local parameters of the subroutine.
mcqs.explanation: This pointer is used to track the current position of the stack being used.

mcqs.question: The reserved memory or private space of the subroutine gets deallocated when _______

options.a: a) The stop instruction is executed by the routine
options.b: b) The pointer reaches the end of the space

mcqs.question: The private space gets allocated to each subroutine when _________

options.c: c) When the routine gets called
options.d: d) When the Allocate instruction is executed

mcqs.question: _____ the most suitable data structure used to store the return addresses in the case of nested subroutines.

mcqs.question: In the case of nested subroutines, the stack top is always _________

options.a: a) The saved contents of the called sub routine
options.b: b) The saved contents of the calling sub routine
options.c: c) The return addresses of the called sub routine

mcqs.answer: a) The saved contents of the called sub routine
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The stack frame for each subroutine is present in ______

mcqs.question: The data structure suitable for scheduling processes is _______

mcqs.question: The sub-routine service procedure is similar to that of the interrupt service routine in ________

options.d: d) Method of context switch & Process execution

title: 3. Computer Architecture MCQ on Input/Output Organisation

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Accessing I/O Devices”.

mcqs.question: In memory-mapped I/O ____________

options.a: a) The I/O devices and the memory share the same address space
options.b: b) The I/O devices have a separate address space
options.c: c) The memory and I/O devices have an associated address space
options.d: d) A part of the memory is specifically set aside for the I/O operation

mcqs.answer: a) The I/O devices and the memory share the same address space
mcqs.explanation: Its the different modes of accessing the i/o devices.

mcqs.question: The usual BUS structure used to connect the I/O devices is ___________

options.d: d) Node to Node BUS structure

mcqs.explanation: BUS is a collection of address, control and data lines used to connect the various devices of the computer.

mcqs.question: In intel’s IA-32 architecture there is a separate 16 bit address space for the I/O devices.
mcqs.explanation: This type of access is called as I/O mapped devices.

mcqs.question: The advantage of I/O mapped devices to memory mapped is ___________

options.a: a) The former offers faster transfer of data
options.b: b) The devices connected using I/O mapping have a bigger buffer space
options.c: c) The devices have to deal with fewer address lines

mcqs.answer: c) The devices have to deal with fewer address lines
mcqs.explanation: Since the I/O mapped devices have a separate address space the address lines are limited by the amount of the space allocated.

mcqs.question: The system is notified of a read or write operation by ___________

options.a: a) Appending an extra bit of the address
options.b: b) Enabling the read or write bits of the devices
options.c: c) Raising an appropriate interrupt signal
options.d: d) Sending a special signal along the BUS

mcqs.answer: d) Sending a special signal along the BUS
mcqs.explanation: It is necessary for the processor to send a signal intimating the request as either read or write.

mcqs.question: To overcome the lag in the operating speeds of the I/O device and the processor we use ___________
mcqs.explanation: Buffer spaces stores frequently accessed data in memory to reduce slow disk I/O operations, improving overall system performance. It minimizes the speed gap between fast CPU and slow storage by serving data quickly from memory instead of accessing the disk repeatedly.

mcqs.question: The method of accessing the I/O devices by repeatedly checking the status flags is ___________
mcqs.explanation: In this method, the processor constantly checks the status flags, and when it finds that the flag is set it performs the appropriate operation.

mcqs.question: The method of synchronising the processor with the I/O device in which the device sends a signal when it is ready is?
mcqs.explanation: This is a method of accessing the I/O devices which gives the complete power to the devices, enabling them to intimate the processor when they’re ready for transfer.

mcqs.question: The method which offers higher speeds of I/O transfers is ___________
mcqs.explanation: In DMA the I/O devices are directly allowed to interact with the memory without the intervention of the processor and the transfers take place in the form of blocks increasing the speed of operation.

mcqs.question: The process wherein the processor constantly checks the status flags is called as ___________
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: Which of the following allows the processor to check the status of an I/O device and proceed without waiting?
mcqs.explanation: Status flags indicate whether an I/O device is ready or busy, allowing the processor to check periodically and continue execution instead of waiting.

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Interrupts – 1”.

mcqs.question: The interrupt-request line is a part of the ___________
mcqs.explanation: The Interrupt-request line is a control line along which the device is allowed to send the interrupt signal.

mcqs.question: The return address from the interrupt-service routine is stored on the ___________
mcqs.explanation: The Processor after servicing the interrupts as to load the address of the previous process and this address is stored in the stack.

mcqs.question: The signal sent to the device from the processor to the device after receiving an interrupt is ___________
mcqs.explanation: The Processor upon receiving the interrupt should let the device know that its request is received.

mcqs.question:
When the process is returned after an interrupt service ______ should be loaded again. i) Register contents
ii) Condition codes
iii) Stack contents
iv) Return addresses
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The time between the receiver of an interrupt and its service is ______
mcqs.explanation: The delay in servicing of an interrupt happens due to the time is taken for contact switch to take place.

mcqs.question: Interrupts form an important part of _____ systems.
mcqs.explanation: This forms an important part of the Real time system since if a process arrives with greater priority then it raises an interrupt and the other process is stopped and the interrupt will be serviced.

mcqs.question: A single Interrupt line can be used to service n different devices.
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question:
______ type circuits are generally used for interrupt service lines. i) open-collector
ii) open-drain
iii) XOR
iv) XNOR
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The resistor which is attached to the service line is called _____
mcqs.explanation: This resistor is used to pull up the voltage of the interrupt service line.

mcqs.question: An interrupt that can be temporarily ignored is ___________
mcqs.explanation: The maskable interrupts are usually low priority interrupts which can be ignored if a higher priority process is being executed.

mcqs.question: The 8085 microprocessor responds to the presence of an interrupt ___________

options.a: a) As soon as the trap pin becomes ‘LOW’
options.b: b) By checking the trap pin for ‘high’ status at the end of each instruction fetch
options.c: c) By checking the trap pin for ‘high’ status at the end of execution of each instruction
options.d: d) By checking the trap pin for ‘high’ status at regular intervals

mcqs.answer: c) By checking the trap pin for ‘high’ status at the end of execution of each instruction
mcqs.explanation: The 8085 microprocessor are designed to complete the execution of the current instruction and then to service the interrupts.

mcqs.question: CPU as two modes privileged and non-privileged. In order to change the mode from privileged to non-privileged.

options.a: a) A hardware interrupt is needed
options.b: b) A software interrupt is needed
options.c: c) Either hardware or software interrupt is needed
options.d: d) A non-privileged instruction (which does not generate an interrupt)is needed

mcqs.answer: b) A software interrupt is needed
mcqs.explanation: A software interrupt by some program which needs some CPU service, at that time the two modes can be interchanged.

mcqs.question: Which interrupt is unmaskable?
mcqs.explanation: The trap is a non-maskable interrupt as it deals with the ongoing process in the processor. The trap is initiated by the process being executed due to lack of data required for its completion. Hence trap is unmaskable.

mcqs.question:
From amongst the following given scenarios determine the right one to justify interrupt mode of data transfer. i) Bulk transfer of several kilo-byte
ii) Moderately large data transfer of more than 1kb
iii) Short events like mouse action
iv) Keyboard inputs
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: How can the processor ignore other interrupts when it is servicing one ___________

options.a: a) By turning off the interrupt request line
options.b: b) By disabling the devices from sending the interrupts
options.c: c) BY using edge-triggered request lines

mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: When dealing with multiple devices interrupts, which mechanism is easy to implement?
mcqs.explanation: In this method, the processor checks the IRQ bits of all the devices, whichever is enabled first that device is serviced.

mcqs.question: The interrupt servicing mechanism in which the requesting device identifies itself to the processor to be serviced is ___________
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: In vectored interrupts, how does the device identify itself to the processor?

options.a: a) By sending its device id
options.b: b) By sending the machine code for the interrupt service routine
options.c: c) By sending the starting address of the service routine

mcqs.answer: c) By sending the starting address of the service routine
mcqs.explanation: By sending the starting address of the routine the device ids the routine required and thereby identifying itself.

mcqs.question: The code sent by the device in vectored interrupt is _____ long.
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The starting address sent by the device in vectored interrupt is called as __________
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The processor indicates to the devices that it is ready to receive interrupts ________

options.a: a) By enabling the interrupt request line
options.b: b) By enabling the IRQ bits
options.c: c) By activating the interrupt acknowledge line

mcqs.answer: c) By activating the interrupt acknowledge line
mcqs.explanation: When the processor activates the acknowledge line the devices send their interrupts to the processor.

mcqs.question:
We describe a protocol of input device communication below: i) Each device has a distinct address.

iii) The device ready to communicate leaves its data in the I/O register
iv) The data is picked up and the controller moves to the step a
Identify the form of communication best describes the I/O mode amongst the following.

options.a: a) Programmed mode of data transfer

mcqs.explanation: In polling, the processor checks each of the devices if they wish to perform data transfer and if they do it performs the particular operation.

mcqs.question:
Which one of the following is true with regard to a CPU having a single interrupt request line and single interrupt grant line? i) Neither vectored nor multiple interrupting devices is possible.
ii) Vectored interrupts is not possible but multiple interrupting devices is possible.
iii) Vectored interrupts is possible and multiple interrupting devices is not possible.
iv) Both vectored and multiple interrupting devices are possible.
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: Which table handle stores the addresses of the interrupt handling sub-routines?
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: _________ method is used to establish priority by serially connecting all devices that request an interrupt.
mcqs.explanation: In the Daisy chain mechanism, all the devices are connected using a single request line and they’re serviced based on the interrupting device’s priority.

mcqs.question: In daisy chaining device 0 will pass the signal only if it has _______

options.c: c) Both No interrupt and Interrupt request

mcqs.explanation: In daisy chaining since there is only one request line and only one acknowledges line, the acknowledge signal passes from device to device until the one with the interrupt is found.

mcqs.question: ______ interrupt method uses register whose bits are set separately by interrupt signal for each device.
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: ______________ register is used for the purpose of controlling the status of each interrupt request in parallel priority interrupt.
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The added output of the bits of the interrupt register and the mask register is set as an input of ______________
mcqs.explanation: In a parallel priority system, the priority of the device is obtained by adding the contents of the interrupt register and the mask register.

mcqs.question: Interrupts initiated by an instruction is called as _______
mcqs.explanation: Interrupts that are generated explicitly by executing an instruction (such as INT or TRAP) are known as Software Interrupts. Internal interrupts, on the other hand, occur due to errors like divide by zero, overflow, etc., and are not intentionally initiated by instructions.

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Exceptions”.

mcqs.question: If during the execution of an instruction an exception is raised then __________

options.a: a) The instruction is executed and the exception is handled
options.b: b) The instruction is halted and the exception is handled
options.c: c) The processor completes the execution and saves the data and then handle the exception

mcqs.answer: b) The instruction is halted and the exception is handled
mcqs.explanation: Since the interrupt was raised during the execution of the instruction, the instruction cannot be executed and the exception is served immediately.

mcqs.question: _____ is/are types of exceptions.
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The program used to find out errors is called __________
mcqs.explanation: Debugger is a program used to detect and correct errors in the program.

mcqs.question: The two facilities provided by the debugger is __________

options.d: d) Both Trace and Break points

mcqs.answer: d) Both Trace and Break points
mcqs.explanation: The debugger provides us with the two facilities to improve the checking of errors.

mcqs.question: In trace mode of operation is ________

options.a: a) The program is interrupted after each detection
options.b: b) The program will not be stopped and the errors are sorted out after the complete program is scanned
options.c: c) There is no effect on the program, i.e the program is executed without rectification of errors
options.d: d) The program is halted only at specific points

mcqs.answer: a) The program is interrupted after each detection
mcqs.explanation: In trace mode, the program is checked line by line and if errors are detected then exceptions are raised right away.

mcqs.question: What is the operation in Breakpoint mode?

options.a: a) The program is interrupted after each detection
options.b: b) The program will not be stopped and the errors are sorted out after the complete program is scanned
options.c: c) There is no effect on the program, i.e the program is executed without rectification of errors
options.d: d) The program is halted only at specific points

mcqs.answer: d) The program is halted only at specific points
mcqs.explanation: The Breakpoint mode of operation allows the program to be halted at only specific locations.

mcqs.question: What are the different modes of operation of a computer?

options.d: d) Supervisor, User and Trace mode

mcqs.explanation: The user programs are in the user mode and the system crucial programs are in the supervisor mode.

mcqs.question: The instructions which can be run only supervisor mode are?
mcqs.explanation: These instructions are those which can are crucial for the system’s performance and hence cannot be adultered by user programs, so is run only in supervisor mode.

mcqs.question: A privilege exception is raised __________

options.a: a) When a process tries to change the mode of the system
options.b: b) When a process tries to change the priority level of the other processes
options.c: c) When a process tries to access the memory allocated to other users

mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: How is a privilege exception dealt with?

options.a: a) The program is halted and the system switches into supervisor mode and restarts the program execution
options.b: b) The Program is stopped and removed from the queue
options.c: c) The system switches the mode and starts the execution of a new process
options.d: d) The system switches mode and runs the debugger

mcqs.answer: a) The program is halted and the system switches into supervisor mode and restarts the program execution
mcqs.explanation: None.

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Direct Memory Access”.

mcqs.question: The DMA differs from the interrupt mode by __________

options.a: a) The involvement of the processor for the operation
options.b: b) The method of accessing the I/O devices
options.c: c) The amount of data transfer possible

mcqs.explanation: DMA is an approach of performing data transfers in bulk between memory and the external device without the intervention of the processor.

mcqs.question: The DMA transfers are performed by a control circuit called as __________
mcqs.explanation: The Controller performs the functions that would normally be carried out by the processor.

mcqs.question: In DMA transfers, the required signals and addresses are given by the __________
mcqs.explanation: The DMA controller acts as a processor for DMA transfers and overlooks the entire process.

mcqs.question: After the completion of the DMA transfer, the processor is notified by __________
mcqs.explanation: The controller raises an interrupt signal to notify the processor that the transfer was complete.

mcqs.question: The DMA controller has _______ registers.
mcqs.explanation: The Controller uses the registers to store the starting address, word count and the status of the operation.

mcqs.question: When the R/W bit of the status register of the DMA controller is set to 1.

options.c: c) Read & Write operation is performed

mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The controller is connected to the ____
mcqs.explanation: The controller is directly connected to the system BUS to provide faster transfer of data.

mcqs.question: Can a single DMA controller perform operations on two different disks simultaneously?
mcqs.explanation: The DMA controller can perform operations on two different disks if the appropriate details are known.

mcqs.question: The technique whereby the DMA controller steals the access cycles of the processor to operate is called __________
mcqs.explanation: The controller takes over the processor’s access cycles and performs memory operations.

mcqs.question: The technique where the controller is given complete access to main memory is __________
mcqs.explanation: The controller is given full control of the memory access cycles and can transfer blocks at a faster rate.

mcqs.question: The controller uses _____ to help with the transfers when handling network interfaces.
mcqs.explanation: The controller stores the data to transfer in the buffer and then transfers it.

mcqs.question: To overcome the conflict over the possession of the BUS we use ______
mcqs.explanation: The BUS arbitrator is used to overcome the contention over the BUS possession.

mcqs.question: The registers of the controller are ______
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: When the process requests for a DMA transfer?

options.a: a) Then the process is temporarily suspended
options.d: d) process is temporarily suspended & Another process gets executed

mcqs.explanation: The process requesting the transfer is paused and the operation is performed, meanwhile another process is run on the processor.

mcqs.question: The DMA transfer is initiated by _____
mcqs.explanation: The transfer can only be initiated by an instruction of a program being executed.

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Bus Arbitration”.

mcqs.question: To resolve the clash over the access of the system BUS we use ______
mcqs.explanation: The BUS arbitrator is used to allow a device to access the BUS based on certain parameters.

mcqs.question: The device which is allowed to initiate data transfers on the BUS at any time is called _____
mcqs.explanation: The device which is currently accessing the BUS is called as the BUS master.

mcqs.question: ______ BUS arbitration approach uses the involvement of the processor.
mcqs.explanation: In this approach, the processor takes into account the various parameters and assigns the BUS to that device.

mcqs.question: The circuit used for the request line is a _________
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The Centralised BUS arbitration is similar to ______ interrupt circuit.
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: When the processor receives the request from a device, it responds by sending _____
mcqs.explanation: The Grant signal is passed from one device to the other until the device that has requested is found.

mcqs.question: In Centralised Arbitration ______ is/are is the BUS master.

options.d: d) Both Processor and DMA controller

mcqs.answer: d) Both Processor and DMA controller
mcqs.explanation: The BUS master is the one that decides which will get the BUS.

mcqs.question: Once the BUS is granted to a device ___________

options.a: a) It activates the BUS busy line

mcqs.answer: a) It activates the BUS busy line
mcqs.explanation: The BUS busy activated indicates that the BUS is already allocated to a device and is being used.

mcqs.question: The BUS busy line is made of ________
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: After the device completes its operation _____ assumes the control of the BUS.
mcqs.explanation: After the device completes the operation it releases the BUS and the processor takes over it.

mcqs.question: The BUS busy line is used __________

options.a: a) To indicate the processor is busy
options.b: b) To indicate that the BUS master is busy
options.c: c) To indicate the BUS is already allocated

mcqs.answer: c) To indicate the BUS is already allocated
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: Distributed arbitration makes use of ______
mcqs.explanation: The device uses a 4bit ID number and based on this the BUS is allocated.

options.a: a) Asserts the Start arbitration signal

mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: How is a device selected in Distributed arbitration?

options.a: a) By NANDing the signals passed on all the 4 lines
options.b: b) By ANDing the signals passed on all the 4 lines
options.c: c) By ORing the signals passed on all the 4 lines

mcqs.answer: c) By ORing the signals passed on all the 4 lines
mcqs.explanation: The OR output of all the 4 lines is obtained and the device with the larger value is assigned the BUS.

mcqs.question: If two devices A and B contesting for the BUS have ID’s 5 and 6 respectively, which device gets the BUS based on the Distributed arbitration.
mcqs.explanation: The device Id’s of both the devices are passed on the lines and since the value of B is greater after the Or operation it gets the BUS.

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Synchronous BUS”.

mcqs.question: The primary function of the BUS is __________

options.a: a) To connect the various devices to the cpu
options.b: b) To provide a path for communication between the processor and other devices
options.c: c) To facilitate data transfer between various devices

mcqs.explanation: The BUS is used to allow the passage of commands and data between cpu and devices.

mcqs.question: The classification of BUSes into synchronous and asynchronous is based on __________

options.c: c) The Timing of data transfers

mcqs.explanation: The BUS is classified into different types for the convenience of use and depending on the device.

mcqs.question: The device which starts data transfer is called __________

mcqs.question: The device which interacts with the initiator is __________
mcqs.explanation: The device which receives the commands from the initiator for data transfer.

mcqs.question: In synchronous BUS, the devices get the timing signals from __________

options.a: a) Timing generator in the device

mcqs.explanation: The devices receive their timing signals from the clock line of the BUS.

mcqs.question: The delays caused in the switching of the timing signals is due to __________
mcqs.explanation: The time taken for the signal to reach the BUS from the device or the circuit accounts for this delay.

mcqs.question: The time for which the data is to be on the BUS is affected by __________

options.b: b) Setup time of the device
options.d: d) Propagation delay of the circuit & Setup time of the device

mcqs.question: The Master strobes the slave at the end of each clock cycle in Synchronous BUS.

mcqs.question: Which is fed into the BUS first by the initiator?

mcqs.question: The devices with variable speeds are usually connected using asynchronous BUS.

mcqs.question: In IBM’s S360/370 systems _____ lines are used to select the I/O devices.

mcqs.question: The meter in and out lines are used for __________

mcqs.explanation: The line is used to monitor the usage of the device for a process.

mcqs.question: MRDC stands for _______

mcqs.question: Asynchronous mode of transmission is suitable for systems with multiple peripheral devices.
