mcqs.question: What is the full form of ISA?
mcqs.explanation: The ISA is an architectural standard developed by IBM for its PC’s.

mcqs.question: What is the full form of ANSI?
mcqs.explanation: The ANSI is one of the standard architecture used by companies in designing the systems.

mcqs.question: The video devices are connected to ______ BUS.
mcqs.explanation: The SCSI BUS is used to connect the video devices to a processor by providing a parallel BUS.

mcqs.question: SCSI stands for ___________
mcqs.explanation: The SCSI BUS is used to connect disks and video controllers.

mcqs.question: ISO stands for __________
mcqs.explanation: The ISO is yet another architectural standard, used to design systems.

mcqs.question: The system developed by IBM with ISA architecture is ______
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: IDE disk is connected to the PCI BUS using ______ interface.
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: IDE stands for _________
mcqs.explanation: The IDE interface is used to connect the hard disk to the processor in most of the Pentium processors.

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Parallel Port”.

mcqs.question: The _____ circuit enables the generation of the ASCII code when the key is pressed.
mcqs.explanation: The signal generated upon the pressing of a button is encoded by the encoder circuit into the corresponding ASCII value.

mcqs.question: To overcome multiple signals being generated upon a single press of the button, we make use of ______
mcqs.explanation: When the button is pressed, the contact surfaces bounce and hence it might lead to the generation of multiple signals. In order to overcome this, we use Debouncing circuits.

mcqs.question: The best mode of connection between devices which need to send or receive large amounts of data over a short distance is _____
mcqs.explanation: The parallel port transfers around 8 to 16 bits of data simultaneously over the lines, hence increasing transfer rates.

mcqs.question: The output of the encoder circuit is/are ______

options.b: b) ASCII code and the valid signal

mcqs.answer: b) ASCII code and the valid signal
mcqs.explanation: The encoder outputs the ASCII value along with the valid signal which indicates that a key was pressed.

mcqs.question: The disadvantage of using a parallel mode of communication is ______

options.b: b) Leads to erroneous data transfer

mcqs.explanation: The parallel mode of data transfer is costly as it involves data being sent over parallel lines.

mcqs.question: In a 32 bit processor, the A0 bit of the address line is connected to _____ of the parallel port interface.
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The Status flag circuit is implemented using _____
mcqs.explanation: The circuit is implemented using the edge triggered D flip flop, that is triggered on the rising edge of the valid signal.

mcqs.question: In the output interface of the parallel port, along with the valid signal ______ is also sent.
mcqs.explanation: The idle signal is used to check if the device is idle and ready to receive data.

mcqs.question: DDR stands for __________
mcqs.explanation: This register is used to control the flow of data from the DATAOUT register.

mcqs.question: In a general 8-bit parallel interface, the INTR line is connected to _______
mcqs.explanation: None.

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Serial Port”.

mcqs.question: The mode of transmission of data, where one bit is sent for each clock cycle is ______
mcqs.explanation: In the isochronous mode of transmission, each bit of the data is sent per each cycle.

mcqs.question: The transformation between the Parallel and serial ports is done with the help of ______
mcqs.explanation: The Shift registers are used to output the data in the desired format based on the need.

mcqs.question: The serial port is used to connect basically _____ and processor.
mcqs.explanation: The serial port is used to connect the keyboard and other devices which input or output one bit at a time.

mcqs.question: The double buffer is used for _________

options.a: a) Enabling retrieval of multiple bits of input
options.b: b) Combining the input and output operations

mcqs.answer: a) Enabling retrieval of multiple bits of input
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: ______ to increase the flexibility of the serial ports.

options.a: a) The wires used for ports is changed
options.b: b) The ports are made to allow different clock signals for input and output

mcqs.answer: b) The ports are made to allow different clock signals for input and output
mcqs.explanation: The ports are made more flexible by enabling the input or output of different clock signals for different devices.

mcqs.question: UART stands for ________
mcqs.explanation: The UART is a standard developed for designing serial ports.

mcqs.question: The key feature of UART is _________

options.d: d) Its enhancement of connecting low speed devices

mcqs.answer: d) Its enhancement of connecting low speed devices
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The data transfer in UART is done in ______
mcqs.explanation: This basically means that the data transfer is done in asynchronous mode.

mcqs.question: The standard used in serial ports to facilitate communication is _____
mcqs.explanation: This is a standard that acts as a protocol for message communication involving serial ports.

mcqs.question: In a serial port interface, the INTR line is connected to _____
mcqs.explanation: None.

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “PCI BUS-1”.

mcqs.question: The PCI follows a set of standards primarily used in _____ PC’s.
mcqs.explanation: The PCI BUS has a closer resemblance to IBM architecture.

mcqs.question: The ______ is the BUS used in Macintosh PC’s.
mcqs.explanation: The NuBUS is an extension of the processor BUS in Macintosh PC’s.

mcqs.question: The key feature of the PCI BUS is _________
mcqs.explanation: The PCI BUS was the first to introduce plug and play interface for I/O devices.

mcqs.question: PCI stands for _______
mcqs.explanation: The PCI BUS is used as an extension for the processor BUS.

mcqs.question: The PCI BUS supports _____ address space/s.
mcqs.explanation: The PCI BUS is mainly built to provide a wide range of connectivity for devices.

mcqs.question: ______ address space gives the PCI its plug and plays capability.
mcqs.explanation: The configuration address space is used to store the details of the connected device.

mcqs.question: _____ provides a separate physical connection to the memory.
mcqs.explanation: The PCI bridge is a circuit that acts as a bridge between the BUS and the memory.

mcqs.question: When transferring data over the PCI BUS, the master as to hold the address until the completion of the transfer to the slave.
mcqs.explanation: The address is stored by the slave in a buffer and hence it is not required by the master to hold it.

mcqs.question: The master is also called as _____ in PCI terminology.
mcqs.explanation: The Master is also called as an initiator in PCI terminology as it is the one that initiates a data transfer.

mcqs.question: Signals whose names end in ____ are asserted in the low voltage state.
mcqs.explanation: None.

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “PCI BUS-2”.

mcqs.question: A complete transfer operation over the BUS, involving the address and a burst of data is called _____
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The device connected to the BUS are given addresses of ____ bit.
mcqs.explanation: Each of the devices connected to the BUS will be allocated an address during the initialization phase.

mcqs.question: The PCI BUS has _____ interrupt request lines.
mcqs.explanation: The interrupt request lines are used by the devices connected to raise the interrupts.

mcqs.question: _____ signal is sent by the initiator to indicate the duration of the transaction.
mcqs.explanation: The FRAME signal is used to indicate the time required by the device.

mcqs.question: ______ signal is used to enable commands.
mcqs.explanation: The signal is used to enable 4 command lines.

mcqs.question: IRDY# signal is used for _______

options.c: c) Saying that the initiator is ready

mcqs.answer: c) Saying that the initiator is ready
mcqs.explanation: The initiator transmits this signal to tell the target that it is ready.

mcqs.question: The signal used to indicate that the slave is ready is _____
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: DEVSEL# signal is used _________

options.b: b) To list all the devices connected
options.c: c) By the device to indicate that it is ready for a transaction

mcqs.answer: c) By the device to indicate that it is ready for a transaction
mcqs.explanation: This is signal is activated by the device after it as recognized the address and commands put on the BUS.

mcqs.question: The signal used to initiate device select ________
mcqs.explanation: This signal is used to initialization of device select.

mcqs.question: The PCi BUS allows us to connect _______ I/O devices.
mcqs.explanation: The PCI BUS allows only 21 devices to be connected as only the higher order 21 bits of the 32 bit address space is used to specify the device.

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “SCSI BUS-1”.

mcqs.question: The key features of the SCSI BUS are _________

options.a: a) The cost effective connective media
options.b: b) The ability overlap data transfer requests
options.c: c) The highly efficient data transmission

mcqs.answer: b) The ability overlap data transfer requests
mcqs.explanation: The SCSI BUS can overlap various data transfer requests by the devices.

mcqs.question: In a data transfer operation involving SCSI BUS, the control is with ______
mcqs.explanation: The initiator involves in the arbitration process and after winning the BUS it’ll hand over the control to the target controller.

mcqs.question: In SCSI transfers the processor is not aware of the data being transferred.
mcqs.explanation: The processor or the controller is unaware of the data being transferred.

mcqs.question: What is DB(P) line?

options.a: a) That the data line is carrying the device information
options.b: b) That the data line is carrying the parity information
options.c: c) That the data line is partly closed
options.d: d) That the data line is temporarily occupied

mcqs.answer: b) That the data line is carrying the parity information
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The BSY signal signifies _________
mcqs.explanation: This signal is generally initiated when the BUS is currently occupied in an operation.

mcqs.question: The SEL signal signifies _________

options.b: b) The device for BUS control is selected
options.c: c) That the target is being selected

mcqs.answer: b) The device for BUS control is selected
mcqs.explanation: This signal is usually asserted during the selection or reselection process.

mcqs.question: ________ signal is asserted when the initiator wishes to send a message to the target.
mcqs.explanation: The ATN signal is short for attention, which is used to intimate the target that the initiator sent a message to it.

mcqs.question: The MSG signal is used _________

options.a: a) To send a message to the target
options.b: b) To receive a message from the mailbox
options.c: c) To tell that the information being sent is a message

mcqs.answer: c) To tell that the information being sent is a message
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: _____ is used to reset all the device controls to their startup state.
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The SCSI BUS uses ______ arbitration.
mcqs.explanation: The SCSI uses distributed arbitration to select the device to give the BUS control.

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “SCSI BUS-2”.

mcqs.question: SCSI stands for ________
mcqs.explanation: The SCSI BUS is one of the expansion BUSes used in a system.

mcqs.question: ANSI stands for _________
mcqs.explanation: This a standard for designing BUSes and other system components.

mcqs.question: A narrow SCSI BUS has _____ data lines.
mcqs.explanation: The SCSI BUS which is narrow is capable of transferring 8 bits of data at a time.

mcqs.question: Single ended transmission means _________

options.a: a) That all the signals have a similar bit pattern
options.b: b) That the signals have a common source
options.c: c) That the signals have a common ground return
options.d: d) That the signals have a similar voltage signature

mcqs.answer: c) That the signals have a common ground return
mcqs.explanation: These type of signals are a common feature of the SCSI BUS.

mcqs.question: HVD stands for _________
mcqs.explanation: This is a type of signaling which uses 5v of current.

mcqs.question: For better transfer rates on the SCSI BUS the length of the cable is limited to ______
mcqs.explanation: To increase the transmission rate in SCSI in SE mode of transfer the wire length is restricted to 1.6m.

mcqs.question: The maximum number of devices that can be connected to SCSI BUS is ______
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The SCSI BUS is connected to the processor through _____
mcqs.explanation: This is used to coordinate and monitor the data transfer over the BUS.

mcqs.question: The mode of data transfer used by the controller is _____
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The data is stored on the disk in the form of blocks called _____
mcqs.explanation: The data is stored on the disk in the form of a collection of blocks called as sectors.

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “USB – 1”.

mcqs.question: The transfer rate, when the USB is operating in low-speed of operation is _____
mcqs.explanation: The USB has two rates of operation the low-speed and the full-speed one.

mcqs.question: The high speed mode of operation of the USB was introduced by _____
mcqs.explanation: The high-speed mode of operation was introduced with USB 2.0, which enabled the USB to operate at 480 Mb/s.

mcqs.question: The sampling process in speaker output is a ________ process.
mcqs.explanation: The isochronous process means each bit of data is separated by a time interval.

mcqs.question: The USB device follows _______ structure.
mcqs.explanation: The USB has a tree structure with the root hub at the centre.

mcqs.question: The I/O devices form the _____ of the tree structure.
mcqs.explanation: The I/o devices form the leaves of the structure.

mcqs.question: USB is a parallel mode of transmission of data and this enables for the fast speeds of data transfers.
mcqs.explanation: The USB does a serial mode of data transfer.

mcqs.question: In USB the devices can communicate with each other.
mcqs.explanation: It allows only the host to communicate with the devices and not between themselves.

mcqs.question: The device can send a message to the host by taking part in _____ for the communication path.
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: When the USB is connected to a system, its root hub is connected to the ________
mcqs.explanation: The USB’s root is connected to the processor directly using the BUS.

mcqs.question: The devices connected to USB is assigned a ____ address.
mcqs.explanation: To make it easier for recognition the devices are given 7 bit addresses.

mcqs.question: The USB address space can be shared by the user’s memory space.
mcqs.explanation: The USB memory space is not under any address spaces and cannot be accessed.

mcqs.question: The initial address of a device just connected to the HUB is ________
mcqs.explanation: By standard, the usual address of a new device is zero.

mcqs.question: Locations in the device to or from which data transfers can take place is called ________
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: A USB pipe is a ______ channel.
mcqs.explanation: This means that the pipe is bi-directional in sending messages or information.

mcqs.question: The type/s of packets sent by the USB is/are _______
mcqs.explanation: This means that the USB gets both data and control signals required for the transfer operation.

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “USB-2”.

mcqs.question: The first field of any packet is _____
mcqs.explanation: The PID is the field that is used to identify the device (the device id).

mcqs.question: The 4 bit PID’s are transmitted twice.
mcqs.explanation: The fields are transmitted twice, once with the true values and the second time with the complemented values.

mcqs.question: The last field in the packet is ______
mcqs.explanation: The last 5 bits of the packet is used for error checking, that is cyclic redundancy check.

mcqs.question: The CRC bits are computed based on the values of the _____
mcqs.explanation: The CRC bits are calculated based on the values of the address and endp.

mcqs.question: The data packets can contain data upto ______
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The most important objective of the USB is to provide ______
mcqs.explanation: The above are all the common features of the USB.

mcqs.question: The transmission over the USB is divided into ____
mcqs.explanation: To support the isochronous mode of operation the usb transmission is divided into frames.

mcqs.question: The _____ signal is used to indicate the beginning of a new frame.
mcqs.explanation: The SOF(State Of Frame) is used to indicate the beginning of a new frame.

mcqs.question: The SOF is transmitted every ______
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The power specification of usb is _____
mcqs.explanation: None.

title: 4. Computer Architecture Multiple Choice Questions on Memory System

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Static Memories”.

mcqs.question: The duration between the read and the mfc signal is ______
mcqs.explanation: The time between the issue of a read signal and the completion of it is called memory access time.

mcqs.question: The minimum time delay between two successive memory read operations is ______
mcqs.explanation: The Time taken by the cpu to end one read operation and to start one more is cycle time.

mcqs.question: MFC is used to _________

options.b: b) Signal to the device that the memory read operation is complete
options.c: c) Signal the processor the memory operation is complete
options.d: d) Assign a device to perform the read operation

mcqs.answer: c) Signal the processor the memory operation is complete
mcqs.explanation: The MFC stands for memory Function Complete.

mcqs.question: __________ is the bottleneck, when it comes computer performance.
mcqs.explanation: The processor can execute instructions faster than they’re fetched, hence cycle time is the bottleneck for performance.

mcqs.question: The logical addresses generated by the cpu are mapped onto physical memory by ____________
mcqs.explanation: The MMU stands for memory management unit, which is used to map logical address onto the physical address.

mcqs.question: VLSI stands for ___________
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The cells in a row are connected to a common line called ______
mcqs.explanation: This means that the cell contents together form one word of instruction or data.

mcqs.question: The cells in each column are connected to ______
mcqs.explanation: The cells in each column are connected to the sense/write circuit using two bit lines and which is in turn connected to the data lines.

mcqs.question: The word line is driven by the _____
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: A 16 X 8 Organisation of memory cells, can store upto _____
mcqs.explanation: It can store upto 128 bits as each cell can hold one bit of data.

mcqs.question: A memory organisation that can hold upto 1024 bits and has a minimum of 10 address lines can be organized into _____
mcqs.explanation: All the others require less than 10 address bits.

mcqs.question: Circuits that can hold their state as long as power is applied is _______
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The number of external connections required in 16 X 8 memory organisation is _____
mcqs.explanation: In the 14, 8-data lines,4-address lines and 2 are sense/write and CS signals.

mcqs.question: The advantage of CMOS SRAM over the transistor one’s is _________
mcqs.explanation: This is because the cell consumes power only when it is being accessed.

mcqs.question: In a 4K-bit chip organisation has a total of 19 external connections, then it has _______ address if 8 data lines are there.
mcqs.explanation: To have 8 data lines and 19 external connections it has to have 9 address lines(i.e 4K = 512 x 8 organisation).

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Asynchronous DRAM”.

mcqs.question: The Reason for the disregarding of the SRAM’s is ________
mcqs.explanation: The reason for the high cost of the SRAM is because of the usage of more number of transistors.

mcqs.question: The disadvantage of DRAM over SRAM is/are _______

options.c: c) The cells are not static

mcqs.answer: c) The cells are not static
mcqs.explanation: This means that the cells won’t hold their state indefinitely.

mcqs.question: The reason for the cells to lose their state over time is ________

options.b: b) Usage of capacitors to store the charge

mcqs.answer: b) Usage of capacitors to store the charge
mcqs.explanation: Since capacitors are used the charge dissipates over time.

mcqs.question: The capacitors lose the charge over time due to ________

options.a: a) The leakage resistance of the capacitor
options.b: b) The small current in the transistor after being turned on
options.c: c) The defect of the capacitor

mcqs.answer: a) The leakage resistance of the capacitor
mcqs.explanation: The capacitor loses charge due to the backward current of the transistor and due to the small resistance.

mcqs.question: _________ circuit is used to restore the capacitor value.
mcqs.explanation: The sense amplifier detects if the value is above or below the threshold and then restores it.

mcqs.question: To reduce the number of external connections required, we make use of ______
mcqs.explanation: We multiplex the various address lines onto fewer pins.

mcqs.question: The processor must take into account the delay in accessing the memory location, such memories are called ______
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: To get the row address of the required data ______ is enabled.
mcqs.explanation: This makes the contents of the row required refreshed.

mcqs.question: In order to read multiple bytes of a row at the same time, we make use of ______
mcqs.explanation: The latch makes it easy to ready multiple bytes of data of the same row simultaneously by just giving the consecutive column address.

mcqs.question: The block transfer capability of the DRAM is called ________
mcqs.explanation: None.

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Synchronous DRAM”.

mcqs.question: The difference between DRAM’s and SDRAM’s is/are ________

options.a: a) The DRAM’s will not use the master slave relationship in data transfer
options.b: b) The SDRAM’s make use of clock
options.c: c) The SDRAM’s are more power efficient

mcqs.answer: b) The SDRAM’s make use of clock
mcqs.explanation: The SDRAM’s make use of clock signals to synchronize their operation.

mcqs.question: The difference in the address and data connection between DRAM’s and SDRAM’s is _______

options.a: a) The usage of more number of pins in SDRAM’s
options.b: b) The requirement of more address lines in SDRAM’s
options.c: c) The usage of a buffer in SDRAM’s

mcqs.answer: c) The usage of a buffer in SDRAM’s
mcqs.explanation: The SDRAM uses buffered storage of address and data.

mcqs.question: A _______ is used to restore the contents of the cells.
mcqs.explanation: The Counter helps to restore the charge on the capacitor.

mcqs.question: The mode register is used to _______

options.a: a) Select the row or column data transfer mode
options.b: b) Select the mode of operation
options.c: c) Select mode of storing the data

mcqs.answer: b) Select the mode of operation
mcqs.explanation: The mode register is used to choose between burst mode or bit mode of operation.

mcqs.question: In a SDRAM each row is refreshed every 64ms.
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The time taken to transfer a word of data to or from the memory is called as ______
mcqs.explanation: The performance of the memory is measured by means of latency.

mcqs.question: In SDRAM’s buffers are used to store data that is read or written.
mcqs.explanation: In SDRAM’s all the bytes of data to be read or written are stored in the buffer until the operation is complete.

mcqs.question: The SDRAM performs operation on the _______

options.a: a) Rising edge of the clock
options.b: b) Falling edge of the clock
options.c: c) Middle state of the clock
options.d: d) Transition state of the clock

mcqs.answer: a) Rising edge of the clock
mcqs.explanation: The SDRAM’s are edge-triggered.

mcqs.question: DDR SDRAM’s perform faster data transfer by _______
mcqs.explanation: By transferring data on both the edges the bandwidth is effectively doubled.

mcqs.question: To improve the data retrieval rate ____________

options.a: a) The memory is divided into two banks
options.c: c) The clock frequency is increased

mcqs.answer: a) The memory is divided into two banks
mcqs.explanation: The division of memory into two banks makes it easy to access two different words at each edge of the clock.

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Large Memories”.

mcqs.question: The chip can be disabled or cut off from an external connection using ______
mcqs.explanation: The chip gets enabled if the CS is set otherwise the chip gets disabled.

mcqs.question: To organise large memory chips we make use of ______
mcqs.explanation: The cell blocks are arranged and put in a memory module.

mcqs.question: The less space consideration as lead to the development of ________ (for large memories).
mcqs.explanation: The SIMM (single inline memory module) or DIMM (dual inline memory module) occupy less space while providing greater memory space.

mcqs.question: The SRAM’s are basically used as ______
mcqs.explanation: The SRAM’s are used as caches as their operation speed is very high.

mcqs.question: The higher order bits of the address are used to _____
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The address lines multiplexing is done using ______
mcqs.explanation: This unit multiplexes the various address lines to lesser pins on the chip.

mcqs.question: The controller multiplexes the addresses after getting the _____ signal.
mcqs.explanation: The controller gets the request from the device needing the memory read or write operation and then it multiplexes the address.

mcqs.question: The RAS and CAS signals are provided by the ______
mcqs.explanation: The multiplexed signal of the controller is split into RAS and CAS.

mcqs.question: Consider a memory organised into 8K rows, and that it takes 4 cycles to complete a read operation. Then the refresh overhead of the chip is ______
mcqs.explanation: The refresh overhead is calculated by taking into account the total time for refreshing and the interval of each refresh.

mcqs.question: When DRAM’s are used to build a complex large memory, then the controller only provides the refresh counter.
mcqs.explanation: None.

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “RamBus Memory”.

mcqs.question: RAMBUS is better than the other memory chips in terms of ________
mcqs.explanation: The RAMBUS is much advanced mode of memory storage.

mcqs.question: The key feature of the RAMBUS tech is ________
mcqs.explanation: The RAMBUS was developed basically to lessen the data transfer time.

mcqs.question: The increase in operation speed is done by ________________
mcqs.explanation: The reference voltage is reduced from the Vsupply about 2v.

mcqs.question: The data is transferred over the RAMBUS as _______
mcqs.explanation: By using voltage swings to transfer data, the transfer rate along with efficiency is improved.

mcqs.question: The type of signaling used in RAMBUS is ______
mcqs.explanation: The differential signaling basically means using voltage swings to transmit data.

mcqs.question: The special communication used in RAMBUS are _________
mcqs.explanation: The special communication link is used to provide the necessary design and required hardware for the transmission.

mcqs.question: The original design of the RAMBUS required for ________ data lines.
mcqs.explanation: Out of the 9 data lines, 8 were used for data transmission and the one left was used for parity checking.

mcqs.question: The RAMBUS requires specially designed memory chips similar to _____
mcqs.explanation: The special memory chip should be able to transmit data on both the edges and is called as RDRAM’s.

mcqs.question: A RAMBUS which has 18 data lines is called as _______
mcqs.explanation: The direct RAMBUS is used to transmit 2 bytes of data at a time.

mcqs.question: The RDRAM chips assembled into larger memory modules called ______
mcqs.explanation: None.

links.context: This set of Computer Organization and Architecture Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Read-Only Memory”.

mcqs.question: If the transistor gate is closed, then the ROM stores a value of 1.
mcqs.explanation: If the gate of the transistor is closed then, the value of zero is stored in the ROM.

mcqs.question: PROM stands for __________
mcqs.explanation: It allows the user to program the ROM.

mcqs.question: The PROM is more effective than ROM chips in regard to _______

options.d: d) Both Cost and Speed of operation

mcqs.answer: d) Both Cost and Speed of operation
mcqs.explanation: The PROM is cheaper than ROM as they can be programmed manually.

mcqs.question: The difference between the EPROM and ROM circuitry is _____

options.a: a) The usage of MOSFET’s over transistors
options.b: b) The usage of JFET’s over transistors
options.c: c) The usage of an extra transistor

mcqs.answer: c) The usage of an extra transistor
mcqs.explanation: The EPROM uses an extra transistor where the ground connection is there in the ROM chip.

mcqs.question: The ROM chips are mainly used to store _______
mcqs.explanation: The ROM chips are used to store boot files required for the system startup.

mcqs.question: The contents of the EPROM are erased by ________

options.b: b) Exposing the chip to UV rays
options.c: c) Exposing the chip to IR rays

mcqs.question: The reason for the implementation of the cache memory is ________

options.b: b) The difference in speeds of operation of the processor and memory

mcqs.answer: b) The difference in speeds of operation of the processor and memory

There is a significant difference in speeds of operation of the processor (GHz) and the main memory due to which processor has to wait un-necessarily for the instruction and data to be fetched from the memory. This wastes a lot of CPU cycles. If we bring these data into the a staging buffer or cache, the processor can continue to operate, thereby increasing the program execution time significantly.

“The difference in speeds of operation of the processor and memory” is the main reason or the trigger for the implementation of cache memory. “reducing memory access and cycle time” is one of the benefits of cache memory, rather than the primary reason for its implementation.
